3.1.en: Arjuna: "If knowledge is better than action, why push me into this fight?" Fair question.
3.1.hi: Arjun: "Agar gyaan action se better hai, toh mujhe ladai mein kyun dhakel rahe ho?" Fair sawaal.

3.2.en: "Your advice feels contradictory. Just give me one clear path." We've all wanted this.
3.2.hi: "Aapki baatein confusing lag rahi hain. Bas ek clear raasta batao." Ye sabne kabhi chaha hai.

3.3.en: Two paths: the path of knowledge for thinkers, the path of action for doers. Both are valid.
3.3.hi: Do raaste: sochne walon ke liye gyaan ka, karne walon ke liye karm ka. Dono valid hain.

3.4.en: Just quitting work doesn't make you free. Escaping isn't the same as growing.
3.4.hi: Kaam chhod dene se freedom nahi milti. Bhaagna aur grow karna alag cheez hai.

3.5.en: Nobody can do nothing, even for a second. Your nature keeps you moving. So move with purpose.
3.5.hi: Koi ek second bhi kuch na kare, ye possible nahi. Nature tumhe chalati rehti hai. Toh purpose ke saath chalo.

3.6.en: Sitting still while your mind binges on cravings? That's just pretending. Fake discipline.
3.6.hi: Baahar se shaant baithe ho par mind cravings mein doob raha hai? Ye bas dikhawa hai. Fake discipline.

3.7.en: Control your mind, then act without clinging to results. That person really stands out.
3.7.hi: Mind control karo, phir result se chipke bina kaam karo. Aisa insaan sach mein alag hota hai.

3.8.en: Doing something beats doing nothing. Even staying alive takes action. Stop waiting for the perfect moment.
3.8.hi: Kuch na karne se kuch karna better hai. Zinda rehne ke liye bhi action chahiye. Perfect moment ka wait band karo.

3.9.en: Work done only for yourself traps you. Work done as an offering sets you free.
3.9.hi: Sirf apne liye kiya kaam phansata hai. Offering ki tarah kiya kaam free karta hai.

3.10.en: From the start, life was designed around giving. Give, and the universe gives back.
3.10.hi: Shuru se life giving pe based hai. Do, aur universe wapas deta hai.

3.11.en: Support each other, and everyone wins. Life works best as a team sport.
3.11.hi: Ek dusre ko support karo, sab jeetenge. Life team sport ki tarah best chalti hai.

3.12.en: Taking from the world without giving anything back? That's basically stealing.
3.12.hi: Duniya se lete raho aur kuch wapas na do? Ye basically chori hai.

3.13.en: Share first, then enjoy. Living only for yourself leaves you empty.
3.13.hi: Pehle share karo, phir enjoy karo. Sirf apne liye jeena khaali kar deta hai.

3.14.en: Food comes from rain, rain from nature's cycle, and that cycle runs on everyone's effort. It's all connected.
3.14.hi: Khaana baarish se, baarish nature ke cycle se, aur woh cycle sabke effort se chalta hai. Sab connected hai.

3.15.en: Every action traces back to something bigger. The divine is present in every act of giving.
3.15.hi: Har action kisi badi cheez se juda hai. Har dene wale kaam mein divine maujood hai.

3.16.en: Living just for your own pleasure, ignoring the cycle? That's a wasted life.
3.16.hi: Sirf apne maze ke liye jeena, cycle ko ignore karna? Ye zindagi waste karna hai.

3.17.en: When you're truly at peace with yourself, you don't need anything to prove.
3.17.hi: Jab tum khud se sach mein khush ho, toh kuch prove karne ki zaroorat nahi rehti.

3.18.en: Someone fully content has nothing to gain or lose from doing or not doing. Total freedom.
3.18.hi: Jo poori tarah santusht hai, use karne ya na karne se kuch milta-jaata nahi. Total freedom.

3.19.en: So do what needs to be done, without attachment. That's the path to the highest.
3.19.hi: Toh jo karna zaroori hai woh karo, bina attachment ke. Yahi sabse upar ka raasta hai.

3.20.en: King Janaka reached the top while working. And you set an example for others too.
3.20.hi: Raja Janak ne kaam karte hue hi top achieve kiya. Aur tum dusron ke liye example bhi ho.

3.21.en: People copy what leaders do. Whatever standard you set, others will follow. Be a good influence.
3.21.hi: Log leaders ko copy karte hain. Jo standard tum set karoge, log follow karenge. Achha influence bano.

3.22.en: Krishna: "I have nothing left to achieve, and I still keep working." Ultimate role model.
3.22.hi: Krishna: "Mujhe kuch achieve nahi karna, phir bhi main kaam karta hoon." Ultimate role model.

3.23.en: "If I stopped working, everyone would copy me and stop too."
3.23.hi: "Agar main kaam rok doon, toh sab mujhe copy karke ruk jaayenge."

3.24.en: "If I quit, the world falls into chaos." When people look up to you, your actions matter.
3.24.hi: "Main ruk gaya toh duniya mein chaos ho jaayega." Jab log tumhe dekhte hain, tumhara action matter karta hai.

3.25.en: Others work for personal gain. The wise work just as hard, but for the good of everyone.
3.25.hi: Dusre apne fayde ke liye kaam karte hain. Samajhdaar utni hi mehnat karte hain, par sabke bhale ke liye.

3.26.en: Don't confuse people who are still learning. Lead by doing, not by lecturing.
3.26.hi: Jo abhi seekh rahe hain unhe confuse mat karo. Lecture nahi, karke dikhao.

3.27.en: Nature is doing most of the work. Ego just jumps in and says "I did this."
3.27.hi: Zyada kaam nature karti hai. Ego beech mein aake kehta hai "maine kiya."

3.28.en: Understand how nature works, and you stop taking everything personally. No attachment.
3.28.hi: Nature kaise kaam karti hai ye samjho, toh har cheez personally lena band ho jaata hai.

3.29.en: People stuck in their patterns need patience, not judgement. Don't shake them up unnecessarily.
3.29.hi: Jo apne patterns mein phanse hain, unhe patience chahiye, judgement nahi. Bina wajah unhe mat hilao.

3.30.en: Hand over your actions to me, drop the ego and anxiety, and do what needs doing. Calmly.
3.30.hi: Apne karm mujhe saunp do, ego aur anxiety chhodo, aur jo karna hai woh karo. Shaanti se.

3.31.en: Those who live this with trust and without overthinking it are set free.
3.31.hi: Jo isko bharose ke saath jeete hain, bina overthinking ke, woh free ho jaate hain.

3.32.en: Those who mock it and ignore it miss out completely. Their loss.
3.32.hi: Jo iska mazaak udaate hain aur ignore karte hain, woh sab miss kar dete hain. Unka nuksaan.

3.33.en: Everyone acts according to their nature, even smart people. Suppressing it doesn't work. Channel it instead.
3.33.hi: Har koi apni nature ke hisaab se chalta hai, smart log bhi. Dabaana kaam nahi karta. Sahi direction do.

3.34.en: Likes and dislikes are built into your senses. Don't let them boss you around. They're your enemies.
3.34.hi: Pasand-naapasand senses mein built-in hai. Unhe apna boss mat banne do. Woh tumhare dushman hain.

3.35.en: Your own path done imperfectly beats someone else's done perfectly. Stop copy-pasting lives off your feed.
3.35.hi: Apna raasta imperfect bhi better hai, kisi aur ka perfect copy karne se. Feed se life copy-paste mat karo.

3.36.en: Arjuna: "Why do we do wrong things even when we don't want to?" Most relatable question ever.
3.36.hi: Arjun: "Hum na chahte hue bhi galat kaam kyun kar dete hain?" Sabse relatable sawaal.

3.37.en: Krishna: "It's desire, and the anger that follows it. That's the real enemy."
3.37.hi: Krishna: "Ye desire hai, aur uske baad aane wala gussa. Asli dushman yahi hai."

3.38.en: Like smoke over fire or dust on a mirror, desire covers up your clarity.
3.38.hi: Jaise aag pe dhuaan ya sheeshe pe dhool, waise desire tumhari clarity ko dhak deta hai.

3.39.en: Desire is never satisfied. Feed it and it just wants more. It blocks your wisdom.
3.39.hi: Desire kabhi satisfy nahi hota. Jitna khilao, utna aur maangta hai. Gyaan ko block kar deta hai.

3.40.en: Desire hides in your senses, mind and thinking. That's how it takes over.
3.40.hi: Desire tumhare senses, mind aur soch mein chhupa rehta hai. Aise hi control le leta hai.

3.41.en: So start with your senses. Get them in check and take down desire early.
3.41.hi: Toh senses se shuru karo. Unhe control karo aur desire ko jaldi khatam karo.

3.42.en: Senses are strong, the mind is stronger, the intellect stronger still. The real you is above it all.
3.42.hi: Senses strong hain, mind usse strong, buddhi usse bhi strong. Asli tum sabse upar ho.

3.43.en: Know who you really are, steady your mind, and defeat desire. Tough enemy, but beatable.
3.43.hi: Jaano tum asli mein kaun ho, mind steady karo, aur desire ko haraao. Mushkil dushman, par haar sakta hai.
